content.description: VESPR is a non-custodial light wallet for the Cardano network, prioritizing the security and safety of your digital assets while ensuring exceptional ease-of-use. VESPR Wallet | Non-custodial Cardano wallet. Your private keys and assets always remain under your control. VESPR is a non-custodial mobile light wallet for the Cardano network that prioritizes the security and safety of your digital assets without compromising on presentation. Your private keys and assets are always in your control. We provide a highly intuitive UI to tailor both the look and feel of the app for any kind of user, whether you are an experienced investor, a Cardano aficionado, and even a novice looking to explore web3.
